g.text: Local restore is independent of the cloud connection.
Turning sync off or losing the folder never stops local saves.
At most one coalescingTask, syncTask, periodicRefreshTask
connectionID fences off old tasks; it is not the persistent deviceID.
Each device writes only its own directory; no cross-device transactions.
Weakly consistent and eventually convergent; no real-time propagation.
authorization / file coordination / versions / decode cache
pointer and snapshot / on-demand reads / queue maintenance
read / write login and login key
runs under the same actor isolation
